Title: Users may be unable to access or perform several actions in Microsoft 365 services
Message:
User impact: Users may have been unable to access or perform several actions in Microsoft 365 services.

Final status: We've confirmed that the services across the previously affected environments have fully recovered and the backlog of email messages has been processed, thus this issue is remediated.

Start time: Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 10:05 AM UTC

End time: Friday, November 13, 2026, at 4:10 PM UTC

This is the final update for the event.
